claims.claim: fish reduce odonate numbers (Bendell & McNicol 1995, relayed by search summaries)
claims.note: Full text paywalled. The Springer abstract is more qualified than the sentence: in small lakes near Sudbury, Ontario (acid-stressed area), Anisoptera larvae only 'tended to be more numerous' in benthic samples from fishless lakes, while their exuviae, and Zygoptera exuviae, were significantly more abundant around fishless lakes; Corixidae were significantly more abundant without fish. In fishless lakes Anisoptera larvae and exuviae were negatively correlated with pH. If kept on the abstract: 'dragonfly and damselfly emergence (exuviae) was higher at fishless lakes (Bendell & McNicol 1995, abstract)'.
